text:
mika: Quick design review — the first-run onboarding checklist feels really dense on mobile. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/ux/onboard-dense.png. Anyone else seeing this? alex: Yep noticed it on my Pixel. All the steps are visible at once and CTAs repeat. Feels overwhelming. priya: Accessibility note: when sample project cards lazy-load the tab focus jumps to the last card. Repro: open `/console`, hit Tab a few times, then wait for cards to render — focus moves unexpectedly. jon: Can you paste a quick repro snippet? I want to reproduce in Sauce/Chromium. Also: we should rank sample projects by likely first-run flows (chat > embeddings > rerank) not just by popularity. sam: Copy nit: change the primary CTA text from `Create sample` to `Create sample project` — clearer for new users. Also do we really need both a banner CTA and a persistent checklist CTA? onboard-bot: [staging] telemetry-consent A/B variant deployed — `/onboard/consent` now serves variant B to 20% of traffic. mika: Proposed fixes: 1) collapse checklist by default with progress bar, allow expanding individual steps; 2) show max 3 sample cards with a `Show more` control; 3) fix keyboard focus trap by moving focus to the step header on expand. alex: Figma prototype: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/onboard-collapse. Implementation note for focus: ensure we set focus programmatically to the revealed header (e.g. `headerEl.focus()`) and maintain logical DOM order. Example markup we recommend: ```
...
``` Add `aria-live` region for progress updates. priya: Also: add `aria-expanded` toggles, and announce step completion via `aria-live="polite"`. Contrast issue: the banner CTA white-on-accent fails WCAG AA at 14px text — need a darker accent or outline. jon: We should instrument an A/B test: collapsed vs inline checklist. Metrics: onboarding completion rate, time-to-first-request, sample-project-create rate. Also track keyboard users dropoff. sam: Microcopy suggestion for collapsed state: header `Get started — 3 steps` and inside `Try a sample project` with subtle hint `You can skip and come back anytime`. Keeps pressure low. mika: Action items: Alex update Figma with collapsed variant + keyboard notes; Eng (jon + alex) to prototype focus behavior; QA run axe + keyboard nav on staging; Priya to update copy and alt text for sample images. I'll create the checklist and assign tickets. alex: Filing ticket now: #5432 "Onboard checklist: collapsed variant + keyboard focus fixes". I'll include acceptance criteria and keyboard test steps. jon: Assigning to eng-oncall pair for initial patch and feature-flag rollout. Will add telemetry events for A/B. priya: Copy PR ready for alt text + CTA change, will link in ticket. sam: :thumbsup: Can we aim for a staged rollout by EOW? If not, incremental is fine. mika: EOW is tight; aiming for EOW but will do incremental behind flag if needed. Thanks everyone. alex: One more thing — we should ensure keyboard users can skip samples with a `Skip` link (visually hidden but focusable). Small a11y win. priya: I'll add that to the copy PR. jon: I'll add A/B toggles + dashboards for the three metrics. mika: Ok closing thread — will follow up with the checklist and ticket links.
